personality.title: Personality Traits
personality.socialStyle_extrovert_desc: You recharge with social interaction, enjoy being with people, and sharing ideas out loud.
personality.socialStyle_introvert_desc: You prefer quiet spaces, recharge in solitude, and think before you speak.
personality.socialStyle_ambivert_desc: You adapt depending on the context: sometimes social, sometimes reserved. A flexible balance.
personality.processingStyle_analytical_desc: Breaks down problems into parts, seeks logic, patterns, and precision.
personality.processingStyle_creative_desc: Generates original ideas, connects unexpected concepts, thinks outside the box.
personality.processingStyle_practical_desc: Seeks functional solutions, applies what has been learned, focuses on the useful.
personality.processingStyle_dreamer_desc: Imagines scenarios, reflects deeply, connects with the emotional and symbolic.
personality.processingStyle_intuitive_desc: Makes quick decisions based on hunches or internal sensations.
personality.processingStyle_reflective_desc: Thinks before acting, analyzes consequences, needs time to process.
personality.processingStyle_sequential_desc: Prefers following ordered steps, structures information in linear processes.
personality.processingStyle_global_desc: Sees the big picture, connects big ideas before going into details.
personality.processingStyle_sensorial_desc: Learns better with physical stimuli: seeing, touching, hearing, experimenting.
personality.processingStyle_verbal_desc: Processes better through language, reading, writing, and conversation.
personality.processingStyle_visual_desc: Prefers images, diagrams, mind maps to understand and remember.
personality.riskTolerance_conservative_desc: Prefers stability, avoids unnecessary risks, values safety and control.
personality.riskTolerance_balanced_desc: Evaluates risks with logic, adapts according to context, seeks balance between safety and opportunity.
personality.riskTolerance_risky_desc: Makes bold decisions, feels comfortable with uncertainty, seeks rapid growth.
personality.decisionMaking_rational_desc: Analyzes data, logic, and consequences before deciding.
personality.decisionMaking_emotional_desc: Decides based on feelings, prioritizes bonds, empathy, and personal values.
personality.decisionMaking_intuitive_desc: Trusts hunches, decides quickly, without needing much information.

How do you process information best?
Knowing your learning style helps us suggest better ways to communicate and collaborate with other users.
cognitive.learning_visual_desc: You learn best with images, diagrams, and colors.
cognitive.learning_auditory_desc: You retain best what you hear, music, and rhythm.
cognitive.learning_kinesthetic_desc: You learn by doing, moving, and physical experimentation.

cognitive.learning_logical_desc: You need structure, sequences, and logical patterns.
cognitive.learning_social_desc: You learn best in groups sharing ideas.
cognitive.learning_solitary_desc: You prefer learning alone, in silence, and with reflection.

communityRules.title: 🌐 ReTh Community Rules
communityRules.intro1: Here you don't just connect with people: here you weave threads of trust, creativity, and collaboration. Every interaction can open an opportunity, a friendship, a project, or simply a good conversation. The possibilities are endless, as long as we respect this space.
communityRules.intro2: We want ReTh to be a safe, inclusive, and authentic environment where everyone can express themselves freely while meeting people. These rules exist to set clear boundaries on what is allowed and what is not. Not following them can have consequences, ranging from warnings to account suspension.

rule1.title: Respect boundaries and consent.
rule1.desc: Nudity and sexually explicit content are not allowed on public profiles. In private conversations, any intimate exchange must be consensual by all parties. Consent is the foundation of every interaction.

rule2.title: Protect your personal information.
rule2.desc: Do not publish sensitive data such as phone numbers, email, social media, or bank accounts on your profile. Do not ask for or share private information of other people. If someone asks you for money or investments, it is likely a scam: report it.

rule3.title: Zero violence.
rule3.desc: Violent, bloody content, or content that glorifies harm to people or animals is not tolerated. Promoting self-harm or the use of weapons is also not allowed. If we detect a risk of harm, we may activate safety and support protocols.

rule4.title: ReTh is not a marketplace.
rule4.desc: Do not use the app to sell products, gain followers, raise funds, or run campaigns. Nor for sexual services, compensated relationships, or “sugar dating”.

rule5.title: Be authentic.
rule5.desc: Do not create fake accounts or impersonate identities. The community wants to meet you, not an invented character.

rule6.title: Communicate with respect.
rule6.desc: Harassment, threats, intimidation, blackmail, sextortion, and doxing are not allowed. There is no room here for racism, intolerance, hate, or discrimination based on race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, appearance, or health status. If someone does not fit your criteria, simply move on.

rule7.title: Do not harm others.
rule7.desc: Any action that suggests, incites, or causes physical, emotional, or digital harm will be taken very seriously. If someone hurts you, take care of yourself first and then decide if you want to report them. We are here to support you.

rule8.title: Adults only.
rule8.desc: You must be at least 18 years old to use ReTh. Photos of minors or childhood images in inappropriate contexts are not allowed.

rule9.title: Obey the law.
rule9.desc: Do not use ReTh for illegal activities: drug sales, counterfeit products, human trafficking, or exploitation of minors.

rule10.title: One account, one person.
rule10.desc: Each account is individual. Do not share your access or create multiple profiles.

rule11.title: Post only your own content.
rule11.desc: Do not share photos, private messages, or material from other people without their consent. Respect copyright and trademarks.

rule12.title: Be an exemplary member.
rule12.desc: Do not spread false information, spam, or harmful links. Do not manipulate or attempt to deceive the community. Do not use external apps to alter ReTh functions.

rule13.title: Stay active.
rule13.desc: If you do not use your account for two years, we may delete it due to inactivity.

communityRules.reportDesc: If someone makes you uncomfortable, harms you, or breaks these rules, report them. Your reports are confidential and help protect the community.
communityRules.impactDesc: We take these rules very seriously. We apply warnings, suspensions, or bans depending on the severity. We may investigate and cancel accounts without refund if we detect misuse of the service, even if it happens outside the app but involves people you met here.
